Tshameka ka me GPS UnifiedNlp Tirelo ya Lefelo
Tetla ya Signature Level, e e tlhokegang go etsa ya me GPS go aba dintšhwafatso tsa lefelo go tsa yone UnifiedNlp Karolo ya kwa morago.
Tiriso "Tshameka ka me GPS" jaaka mofedi wa lefelo la kwa morago fa tirelo ya yone e le mo tirisong.

Palo ya di-millisecond tse di okeditsweng mo letshwaong la nako la dintšhwafatso tsotlhe tsa lefelo. Boleng jo bo lekaneng go lekane bo tshwanetse go netefatsa gore batlamedi ba bangwe botlhe ba backend ba itlhokomolosiwa fa go etsisa go ntse go dira.:
